name: Click to Email
summary: Viewers get an offer sent to their Samsung Account email with one remote click.
description: A discount banner with a Send to Email button. The viewer presses OK, confirms in a popup that the offer goes to the email linked to their Samsung Account, and gets an on-screen notification once it is sent. Advertisers collect leads and deliver coupons without the viewer typing anything on the TV. Requires a signed-in Samsung Account on the TV.
remoteHints: ◀ ▶ choose Send or Cancel in the popup

mocks.caption: Step 1 — Offer banner with the Send to Email button
Step 2 — Confirmation popup: send the offer to the Samsung Account email
Step 3 — Notification confirms the offer was sent
